messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: rolling service-edge v3.4.0 to prod in change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-service-edge-v3.4.0 :rocket; notify #deploy-notify on decision.
nana: Oncall ack. I'll own rollback for first 12m, then hand to will if needed.
will: Release lead. My thresholds: abort if 5xx > 1% OR sustained p95 > 200ms for 4m.
sre-oncall: Preflight OK. Alerting connected. I'll run automated canary-check and post an immediate hold message to this thread if triggers fire.
ops_sam: Runbook note: DB migration guarded by feature-flag; rollback must disable feature-flag before traffic shift. Also: do NOT purge caches until DB consistency verified (see runbook step 5).
prod_jess: CS/Support heads-up: prepare short customer line for rollback: "We reverted a routine rollout and restored the previous stable version; services are stable."
docs_tom: I'll hold changelog merge and queue a revert template PR if rollback occurs.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: stage1 complete (10% traffic). Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/service-edge/canary-3.4.0
nana: Stage1 looks clean. Proceeding to 50%.
will: Rollback command (ops console): `deployctl rollback --service service-edge --env prod --to-tag v3.3.2 --reason "canary-failure"` — runbook order: disable feature-flag -> switch traffic -> verify probes -> then cache prune.
ops_sam: Additional ops flag: include `--preserve-migrations=false` if rolling back to avoid migration attempts. It's explicitly called out in the runbook.
sre-oncall: Canary stage2 (50%) starting. I'll alert here if any anomaly.
nana: Thanks all — will update at 50% or immediately if the canary-check posts a hold. :white_check_mark:
